records.title: Active-Matrix GaN Micro Light-Emitting Diode Display With Unprecedented Brightness
records.process: 0.35 µm silicon CMOS driver; sapphire-grown 450 nm InGaN/GaN LED array
records.architecture: Pitch-matched CMOS switching drivers, separate LED_VDD/GND/LED_GND terminals, bump bonding; grid power rails and larger drive devices studied against prior linear rails

data.label: Array luminance
data.conditions: Device B patterns/full-array section at 3.6 V, approximately 7.7 mA/pixel; pixel pitch 100 µm. This is not our 20 µm/100 µA operating point.

data.label: Realized single-pixel current
data.conditions: Approximately 300 mA in the generation-2 assembly, limited by LED; NOT demonstrated for all pixels simultaneously.

data.label: Simultaneously operated array section
data.conditions: 1×1 mm² section operated at total current 900 mA; different operating point from 300 mA single pixel.

records.locator: IEEE TED 62(6), pp.1918–1925; Section II.A CMOS Layout pp.1919–1920; Fig.2 and Table I; Fig.3 pp.1920; Section II.D/Fig.7 p.1922.
records.supports: Silicon CMOS can drive GaN LEDs; physical PG and LED n-contact geometry alter simultaneous-pixel behavior and voltage headroom.
records.does_not_support: No proof of our mirror precision, our model validity, 20 µm pixel behavior, or a generally applicable current/rate ceiling.
records.notes: Official author-university full text reviewed. PDF includes a cover sheet: journal p.1919 is PDF page 3. High brightness is conditioned on a large 100 µm-pitch device. Avoid converting 10 ns pulse operation into a communication BER claim.

records.title: 17.1: SRAM-based LED CMOS driver circuit for a 512x512 GaN microdisplay
records.process: 0.18 µm silicon CMOS; majority 1.8 V devices plus a 5 V enable/cascode transistor. Author thesis Section 3.4 p.143 identifies OnSemi; conference paper itself says standard 0.18 µm.
records.architecture: Four 6T SRAMs store 4 bits; four weighted PMOS devices supply 16 current states; common enable can add whole-array PWM; two calibration transistors; LED cathode can be −3.2 V with anode ≤1.8 V

data.label: Reported maximum simulated driver current
data.conditions: Section 4/Fig.5: post-layout simulation at LED bias 3.3 and 5 V using the fitted 10 µm-side LED model; 16 current states.

data.label: Maximum Monte Carlo current deviation
data.conditions: Section 4/Fig.5: maximum deviation at maximum drive current; MC error bars describe CMOS variation only; sample count/error-bar statistic not specified in the reviewed section.

data.label: Planned array and pixel pitch
data.conditions: Designed-for 512×512 array, 18 µm pitch, not evidence of optically measured 512×512 pixels in this conference paper.

records.locator: SID Digest 54(S1), pp.135–139 (2023); Section 3 pp.136–137; Section 4/Fig.5 p.137; reproduced author thesis Publication 5, PDF pages 181–185; thesis Section 3.4 p.143 gives foundry context.
records.supports: Digital storage avoids analog capacitor droop; amplitude quantization, common PWM, calibration and mixed-voltage protection can be separated in a circuit design.
records.does_not_support: 120 µA and 10 kfps are not demonstrated full-array optical/silicon measurements in this paper; 1 MHz wording is a switching-rate claim, not a measured rise-time value.
records.notes: Important evidence correction: publisher abstract is optimistic; full Section 4 explicitly says post-layout simulation. Use this as a design/simulation example. Do not import later thesis assembly measurements into the 2023 paper record.
records.cn_guide: 学习SRAM、PAM/PWM与高压enable分工；120 µA与16级来自post-layout仿真。

records.title: Towards high-resolution and high-brightness uniformity near-eye display: heterogeneous integration of GaN-based micro-LED on a custom Si CMOS platform
records.process: Custom Si CMOS backplane; process node not stated in reviewed main text; wafer-bonded green GaN micro-LEDs
records.architecture: SRAM pixel state; 8 binary-weighted subframes with rolling row scan; RAM/controller/address decoding and integrated regulators/sensors/interfaces; circuit and array-supply simulation plus optical prototype

data.label: Simulated DNL/INL upper bound
data.conditions: Both below 0.004 LSB at nominal 1 µA individual pixel; 8-bit 00–FF data; 60 Hz frame split into 8 weighted subframes.

data.label: Simulated mismatch standard deviation
data.conditions: Cadence static mismatch Monte Carlo, 200 samples, mean 1 µA; not 200 measured chips or a measured yield result.

data.label: Measured average areal peak luminance
data.conditions: POMS whole-display areal measurement, green 0.99-inch 1472×1104 prototype, at reported current density 0.5 A/cm².

records.locator: Light: Advanced Manufacturing 7, article 103, pp.971–982, published online 19 August 2026. Results: High-current uniformity CMOS driver circuit/Fig.1; High brightness uniformity micro-LED displays/Fig.4; Materials and methods: Numerical simulation.
records.supports: Pixel current simulation, actual supply network, LED fabrication and optical uniformity require separate evidence; digital PWM can coexist with measured heterogeneous CMOS/LED assembly.
records.does_not_support: Simulated 0.004 LSB/0.2% three-sigma does not prove optical linearity or measured electrical yield; optical uniformity is not an isolated CMOS mismatch test; foundry/node/material stack cannot be inferred.
records.notes: Do not import the article commercial superiority language. Internal condition discrepancy: text says U=90.12% at 0.5 A full-screen, but Fig.4 caption/Table 1 say 0.5 A/cm²; do not quote that uniformity condition as unambiguous. A Gaussian 3σ interpretation with 200 MC samples is model-based, not measured 99.7% manufacturing yield.
records.cn_guide: 学习电流均匀性与异质集成；电路仿真和光学实测分别读，均匀度条件有单位歧义。

records.title: GF180MCU Design Manual 14.1 — Chip operating conditions and thin/thick gate-oxide reliability limits
records.process: GF180MCU 3.3 V LV thin oxide and 5 V/6 V higher-voltage thick gate
records.architecture: Reliability depends on terminal-to-terminal stress, exposure time/duty and operating conditions; nominal supply class is not a universal terminal rating

data.label: Thin-oxide DC gate-to-other-node absolute limit
data.conditions: Section 14.1.4.2; applies between gate and any other FET node, not simply chip supply voltage.

data.label: Nominal voltage classes
data.conditions: Section 14.1.2: 3.3 V LV, 5/6 V HV; drain HCI and gate-oxide constraints must both be satisfied.

records.supports: 6 V vs 3.3 V is a voltage/gate-oxide device choice within silicon CMOS; startup and coupled-node overshoot need terminal stress review.
records.does_not_support: Do not treat a model solving at a voltage as proof of long-term reliability; 3.3 V thin-oxide devices cannot simply replace our 6 V output without a voltage-domain design.
records.notes: Public text lists a thick-gate DC value as 6.5V/6V for the 5V/6V process; avoid rearranging those into a universal 6.6 V gate rating. HCI and TDDB lifetime/duty constraints are separate. No unpublished material stack inferred.

records.title: 1.5 Gbit/s Multi-Channel Visible Light Communications Using CMOS-Controlled GaN-Based LEDs

process.driver: 16 x 16 CMOS driver cells, 100 x 100 um cells; foundry/node not explicitly established in reviewed text
process.LED: Blue 450 nm GaN, 16 x 16 array; 99 x 99 um square pixels, 100 um pitch, common n-contact/individual p-contact; flip-chip bonded

records.architecture: Each CMOS cell is a high-speed digitally triggered switch applying LED bias. Four independent data inputs with a shared clock; source data instruments feed actual CMOS driver cells. It is not direct instrument drive of the LED.

data.conditions: Four simultaneously modulated pixels; OOK-NRZ PRBS 2^7-1; input trigger 0-2 V; applied LED bias 6.5 V

data.label: Measured aggregate rate
data.conditions: Four x 375 Mbit/s; distinct from a single-lane 1.5 Gbit/s result

data.label: Author-defined error-free criterion
data.conditions: Paper defines error-free as BER less than this bound; zero observed errors must not be rewritten as BER=0

data.label: Four-channel received-power penalty
data.conditions: Compared with one-channel operation at the stated rate/error-free criterion
